meta.name: Brave Wilderness
meta.description:
Brave Wilderness is your connection to a world of adventure and amazing animal encounters!  Follow along with Coyote Peterson and Mark Vins as they lead you on a variety of expeditions featuring everything from Grizzly Bears to Crocodiles.

Shows: For the Love of Wolves!, Caught! Dangerous, Blue, & Bloated!, You Won't Believe This Sailfish Catch!, Stung by the Dragon Flame Caterpillar!, Snapped by World's Fastest Jaws!
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
